'''Pyroviathan''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Pyroclobster]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Those fearsome claws wield temperatures that can easily melt steel. Now seen as a hero among Tatari, Pyroviathan has finally learned to tell friend from foe before setting the surroundings ablaze."

Pyroviathan is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
